profile_text.body:
Obsidian is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Los Angeles, CA, that makes a free, flexible note-taking application. The company describes its product as a private, local-first tool for personal notes, journaling, knowledge bases, and project management. Notes are stored on the user's device and remain accessible offline, with the company stating that no one outside the user can read them. Core features include bidirectional note linking, an interactive graph for visualizing relationships between notes, a limitless canvas for brainstorming and diagramming, and an open plugin API that the company says supports thousands of community-built extensions.

Obsidian's AI offering, tracked as Obsidian AI, fits within the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and is characterized as a local-first knowledge AI that emphasizes privacy and operates without cloud dependency. The product's extensibility through plugins is central to its AI positioning. Two third-party MCP servers are registered against the product: one connects AI assistants to GitHub-hosted Obsidian vaults for access and search, and another enables searching a vault by title or keyword and summarizing related content. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
